name: Dah Sing Banking Group Limited
summary: Dah Sing Banking Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides banking, financial, and other related services in Hong Kong, Macau, and the People's Republic of China. It operates Personal Banking, Corporate Banking, Treasury and Global Markets, Mainland China and Macau Banking, and Others segments. The company accepts deposits from individual customers and provides residential mortgage lending, personal loans, overdrafts, vehicle financing, and credit card services, as well as insurance and investment services.
